Character.Traits: Rugged physique, weathered skin, braided hair, broken nose. Speaks in a drawl, wears muddy boots and a stained cloak. Honest, but stubborn.
Character.Bonds: The miller's daughter at Hollowmere saved you from a fever; you owe her a favor she hasn't named yet.
Character.Omens: Crows follow you on the road, three at a time.

Scars.Name: Walloped
Scars.Description: Thrown into the millpond by a root goblin; +2 max HP after the rest.

Notes.Notes: Hired to find out what keeps trampling the barley at Hollowmere. Tracks lead to the old cairn on Wick Hill.
